title.narrative: Delegation Agreement GIZ- Fondo Verde

description.narrative: The action aims at increasing resilience to climate change and variability in vulnerable Central American areas by supporting the implementation of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) and other adaptation and mitigation national and sub-national plans.
